_about: Checked corrections to the granth catalog (lib/granth-catalog-build.mjs). The source tables are never rewritten; these win over what is read from file names and the library book list. 'books' is keyed by granth_library_books.id, 'granths' by Turso granth_key. A granth with duplicate_of is the same edition as that granth and is kept out of search so no word is counted twice. Run `node scripts/granth_catalog_report.mjs` after editing.
